focal.name: Bran Redhand
focal.who: A branded human with steady hands and a short temper.
focal.backstory: Bran Redhand's younger brother killed a reeve's son in a tavern brawl at Millbrook. Bran took the blame to spare him, and was branded on the hand and driven out.

note: personal set pers1 (round T, North Star item 0): one of 8 company soldiers with a varied one-line past (the spark = the backstory's first sentence, as the game's personalSeed reads it)
